# 剧本阶段交接摘要模板

本文件定义创意阶段向剧本开发 Agent 交接的固定格式。

---

## 模板

```yaml
# === 创意→剧本 交接摘要 ===
# 由 creative-bible-and-handoff skill 生成

metadata:
  handoff_id: ""              # HO-creative-001 等
  series_id: ""
  generated_at: ""
  handoff_from: "creative-development-agent"
  handoff_to: "script-development-agent"
  creative_bible_version: ""
  creative_bible_file: ""     # 创意设定文件路径

# === 项目是什么 ===
what_is_this:
  logline: ""                 # 一句话概述
  genre: ""
  style: ""
  target_audience: ""
  platform: ""

# === 故事核心 ===
story_core:
  premise: ""
  core_conflict: ""
  central_question: ""
  emotional_core: ""
  narrative_arc_summary: ""

# === 核心角色 ===
characters:
  protagonist:
    name: ""
    personality: ""
    core_desire: ""
    core_flaw: ""
    starting_state: ""
    arc_direction: ""
    appearance: ""
    signature_look: ""

  supporting:
    - name: ""
      role: ""
      relationship_to_protagonist: ""
      personality: ""
      narrative_function: ""

# === 核心关系 ===
relationships:
  core_relationship: ""
  relationship_type: ""
  core_tension: ""
  relationship_arc: ""

# === 风格基调 ===
style_direction:
  emotional_tone: ""          # 情绪基调
  narrative_rhythm: ""        # 叙事节奏：快/中/慢
  visual_style: ""            # 视觉风格方向
  key_references: []          # 关键参考作品（只列对齐的维度）

# === 世界观 ===
worldbuilding:
  setting: ""
  type: ""
  core_rules: []
  visual_style: ""

# === 生产参数 ===
production_params:
  episode_duration: ""
  episode_count: ""
  segment_duration: ""
  segments_per_episode: ""

# === 锁定与探索 ===
locked_items:
  - item: ""
    reason: ""

explorable_items:
  - item: ""
    boundary: ""              # 探索的边界在哪

flexibility_notes: ""

# === 风险传递 ===
risks_to_note:
  narrative: []
  production: []
  ai_friendly: []

# === 待确认项（必须在剧本开始前解决） ===
pending_before_script:
  - item: ""
    priority: ""
    impact_on_script: ""

# === 禁区 ===
hard_boundaries:
  - item: ""

# === 建议的剧本切入点 ===
suggested_starting_point:
  opening_scene_hint: ""      # 开场场景建议
  first_episode_focus: ""     # 第一集重点
  tone_setting_notes: ""      # 定调说明
```

---

## 使用规则

1. 交接摘要只在创意设定状态为 approved 时才正式生效
2. 创意设定在 in_review 状态时可生成交接摘要供参考，但剧本阶段不可开始
3. locked_items 中列出的设定，剧本 Agent 不得修改
4. explorable_items 中的内容，剧本 Agent 可在 boundary 范围内细化
5. risks_to_note 必须传递给剧本 Agent，作为其创作约束
6. pending_before_script 必须在剧本开始前解决，否则不进入剧本阶段
7. 文件存放路径：`project_data/projects/{project_id}/series/`
8. 文件命名：`script-handoff-v{version}.yaml`
